en-US.description: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness.
en-US.longDescription:
DeepSeek Bot (DS Bot) is a bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that turns DSH into long-lived bots. You create your own bots, then talk and work with them, with bot-to-bot messages and group chats.

The desktop app brings its own DSH, so you do not need to install DSH first. Bots can run tools, keep their own memory and files, and answer side questions while they work.
en-US.name: DS Bot
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- A group's admin can set a goal with you, split it into checked stages for its members and run it to the end; the header shows the current stage and who is working on it, and you can pause, resume, stop or clear the goal. (#791, #795)
- The desktop app opens a start window while it starts up: a ring of three arcs around the Main Bot's whale shows real startup progress, first-run setup shows where your data lives and lets you pick another folder, folder pickers and imports use the app's own cards instead of system dialogs, and every startup error page says what happened and what to do. (#559, #702, #856–#867)
- The memory panel lists each memory's change history and lets you restore a single change from the journal. (#464, #822)
- You can set a default model for new Bots in Settings without changing existing Bots. (#227, #823)
- You can choose whether Enter sends a message or inserts a new line in Bot chats, and while a Bot is working, pressing Enter again on an empty message box sends your queued messages into the running turn right away. (#680, #816, #839, #841)
Changed
- The sidebar slides in and out smoothly with more room between icons in the folded rail, the Bot avatar flies between details and a side chat, consecutive group messages from the same Bot chain together, and floating surfaces use frosted glass. (#502, #802, #805, #806, #819)
- Private chats show when messages were sent, the reply button stays at the bottom of long messages, and a Bot's scheduled tasks show their status, next run and full prompt. (#391, #533, #590, #817, #820, #821)
- Group memory keeps only what outlasts the current task and is passed as a message so group turns share the Bot's prompt cache; skill proposals stay free of file names from that task, and AGENTS.md proposals tolerate small format slips. (#797, #827, #828, #830, #832)
- DS Bot tracks DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 and hides leading reasoning signature blocks in Bot chats. (#812)
Fixed
- In group chats, a Bot that asked another Bot gets the result even while it is still in its own turn, the admin is no longer called by a text match, and a reply that already answers is not asked for again. (#872, #873)
- A group chat no longer goes silent after DeepSeek Harness restarts; if a message cannot be passed on, the group says so. (#826, #840)
- Word, Excel and PowerPoint previews work again in the desktop app on Windows and macOS. (#679, #705)
- Quitting during first-run setup exits even if the folder picker stops answering, and button focus rings and long model names are no longer clipped by their containers. (#401, #824, #847)
- Linux hosts with an older glibc have documented Docker fallback and compatibility guidance. (#683, #825)

zh-CN.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的长期运行机器人团队。
zh-CN.longDescription:
DeepSeek Bot（DS Bot）是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的机器人插件，把 DSH 变成长期运行的机器人。你可以创建自己的机器人并与它们对话、协作，支持机器人之间互发消息和群聊。

桌面应用自带 DSH，无需先安装 DSH。机器人可以运行工具、保存自己的记忆和文件，并在执行任务的同时回答旁路问题。
